why_hard: **The corpus has no round-trip red flag.** Searching all 479 illustrative chunks for circular / round-trip / returns-to-origin language returns nothing. So the honest expectation is that no indicator is correct and grounding proceeds on the obligations alone (LLD §6 EMPTY_INDICATOR_RETRIEVAL) -- not that the retriever should produce a best-effort match which the report then cites as though a regulator had written it down.
